text: Based on the evidence, the tree cover on this asset has not changed significantly since 2020. The data shows that 43.3 hectares (11.55% of the asset) were classified as forest in 2020 by the JRC dataset, and the Hansen dataset confirms tree cover (≥30% canopy) was present in 2000. No recent deforestation or land-use changes are detected in the annual series up to 2025. The corroboration rule requires agreement between datasets, which is met here. Thus, the tree cover remains stable.
